why: The first figure is half a square (left and bottom sides) and the second is the full square. The third figure is the other half (top and right sides), so the next must again be the full square. Option 1 is the complete square. Options 2, 3 and 4 still have one side missing.
trick: Two halves of a square join to make the full square; the pattern repeats half, whole, half, whole.
